deals.travelWindow: Sep 1-2 nonstop JetBlue flash fare at $117; nonstop JetBlue/United fares run $143-146 into October
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $117 RT nonstop, and Shenandoah National Park's Skyline Drive is a 2.5-hour drive from a city built for walking.
deals.soloWhy: The National Mall and Metro system make DC one of the most walkable, transit-friendly capitals for a solo trip, and the free Smithsonian museums fill days without a single reservation.

highlights: National Mall walk: Lincoln Memorial, WWII Memorial, Washington Monument
Smithsonian Air & Space and Natural History museums (free)
Shenandoah National Park's Skyline Drive day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Sunrise walk down the National Mall, Smithsonian museums in the afternoon, dinner in Penn Quarter.
Day 2 — Georgetown's canal towpath and waterfront shops, U Street Corridor for dinner and live jazz.
Day 3 — Drive to Shenandoah National Park for Skyline Drive and a short hike (Stony Man or Old Rag), back for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The Metro covers the monument core, Georgetown, and U Street without a car; rent a car only for the Shenandoah day trip.
guide.stayArea: Penn Quarter or Dupont Circle — walkable to the Mall and a Metro stop.
food: Old Ebbitt Grill (near the White House)

deals.travelWindow: Sat departures Sep 12, 19, 26; Oct 24, 31; Nov 7, 14, 21; Dec 5, 12 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop American
deals.whyRanked: Still one of the cheapest verified fares of the five at $131 RT nonstop; no national park nearby, but the price alone keeps it in the top five.
deals.soloWhy: Deep Ellum's live-music venues and the White Rock Lake trail loop are easy to navigate alone, though the sprawl between neighborhoods calls for a rideshare.

highlights: Dallas Museum of Art and the Dallas Arts District
Deep Ellum murals and live-music clubs
itinerary: Day 1 — Dallas Museum of Art and the Arts District, dinner and live music in Deep Ellum.
Day 2 — Morning walk or bike loop around White Rock Lake, afternoon at the Trinity River Audubon Center trails.
Day 3 — Drive out to the Fort Worth Stockyards for the cattle drive and rodeo history before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: DART light rail covers downtown and Deep Ellum; a rental car is worth it for White Rock Lake, the Audubon Center, and the Fort Worth day trip.
guide.stayArea: Deep Ellum or the Arts District — walkable nightlife and galleries.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 5-12, Sep 16-22, Oct 20-26 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue, United, American, or Delta
deals.whyRanked: $163 RT nonstop JetBlue, and Indiana Dunes National Park's Lake Michigan shoreline is 90 minutes away from one of the most walkable downtowns in the country.
deals.soloWhy: The Loop, Riverwalk, and Magnificent Mile are flat and walkable, the 'L' covers everywhere else, and counter-seating deep-dish and hot-dog spots make solo dining effortless.

highlights: Millennium Park and Cloud Gate ("The Bean")
Indiana Dunes National Park lakeshore hike
itinerary: Day 1 — Riverwalk architecture boat tour, Millennium Park, dinner in the Loop.
Day 2 — Art Institute of Chicago in the morning, Magnificent Mile in the afternoon, sunset at 360 Chicago.
Day 3 — Drive to Indiana Dunes National Park for a lakeshore hike (Mount Baldy or West Beach) before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The 'L' and Riverwalk cover downtown and most neighborhoods on foot or by train; a rental car is only needed for the Indiana Dunes day trip.
guide.stayArea: The Loop or River North — walkable to the Riverwalk and 'L' stops.

deals.travelWindow: Sep-Dec 2026, cheapest one-stop fares on American or Southwest; wide date availability through mid-December
deals.whyRanked: $199 RT with one stop is the priciest fare confirmed so far, but Multnomah Falls and Mount Hood are both under 90 minutes from a city built around food-cart culture and solo-friendly transit.

nearbyParks.name: Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area

deals.soloWhy: The compact downtown, MAX light rail, and food-cart pods make solo exploring and eating effortless, and the city's laid-back pace suits traveling alone.

highlights: Mount Hood's Timberline Lodge day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Powell's City of Books, a food-cart lunch, Pearl District galleries, dinner in Southeast Portland.
Day 2 — Washington Park's Japanese Garden and International Rose Test Garden, Alberta Arts District murals and dinner.
Day 3 — Drive the Historic Columbia River Highway to Multnomah Falls, or push on to Mount Hood's Timberline Lodge, before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: MAX light rail and the streetcar cover downtown and the Pearl District; a rental car is needed for the Gorge or Mount Hood.
guide.stayArea: Pearl District or downtown — walkable to food carts and the streetcar.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 3-10 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop outbound on Delta (one-stop return)
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $215 RT with a nonstop outbound leg, but the Everglades' Royal Palm entrance is 45 minutes from downtown, and South Beach is endlessly walkable.
deals.soloWhy: South Beach's boardwalk and Coconut Grove's shaded streets are easy solo walks, and the free Metromover removes the need for a rideshare downtown.

highlights: Miami Beach Boardwalk and South Beach Art Deco district
Bayside Marketplace and a Biscayne Bay boat tour
Everglades airboat tour or Anhinga Trail walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the Miami Beach Boardwalk, South Beach's Art Deco district at sunset, dinner in South Beach.
Day 2 — Coconut Grove in the morning, Bayside Marketplace and a Biscayne Bay boat tour midday, Wynwood Walls at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Everglades: the Anhinga Trail boardwalk and an airboat tour before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free Metromover covers downtown and Brickell, and South Beach is walkable on its own; a rental car is the easiest way to reach the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: South Beach or Coconut Grove — walkable, close to the water.
